report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: all sampled checkout traces return HTTP 200 across order, inventory, payment and postgres, and order metrics show 21.3 successful /v1/orders 200 responses with zero 502s. The only deployment record is baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version, so no faulty deployment is established. No bounded cause is supported; hand off.
missing_evidence: Error-bearing checkout traces or logs showing non-200 responses to substantiate any checkout error claim
Deployment records showing a version change or regression on order/checkout services
Metrics or logs evidencing db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak or bad-configuration
